caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a standing woman with long dark hair, wearing a feathered headdress and a necklace. She is dressed in a knee-length, reddish dress with gold fringe trim, a red sash or belt at the waist, and holds a bundle of tobacco leaves under one arm and a flat tray or bundle in her opposite hand. Her legs are covered by vertically striped stockings in alternating dark and light colors. She stands on a rectangular block base that is colored in muted brownish and yellowish tones, with the word "CIGARS" painted on the front in gold capital letters. The background is plain and unadorned, composed of a light cream or off-white color.
title: Cigar Store Indian
